content.story.heading: One story from our work
content.about.lead: The Maa Kalawati Foundation is a charitable foundation based in Gurugram, Haryana, devoted to improving lives through healthcare support, education, women empowerment and community welfare.
content.about.story1: The Foundation is named in honour of Maa Kalawati — a mother whose care never asked for anything in return. Her way of living, where no one at the door went away empty-handed, is the standard we hold ourselves to.
content.about.story2: We work from Sikanderpur on MG Road, Gurugram, and our door is open in the same way hers was: to a patient who cannot afford care, to a child at risk of dropping out of school, to a woman ready to stand on her own feet, to a family carrying more than it can hold.
content.about.story3: We are a small team, and we like it that way — close to the ground, careful with every rupee, and present in person. What we promise, we do.
content.about.mission: To bring healthcare, education and opportunity within reach of families who would otherwise go without — with dignity, warmth and complete transparency.
content.about.vision: A community where no illness goes untreated for want of money, no child leaves school for want of support, and no woman is held back for want of opportunity.
content.donate.intro: Every rupee you give goes to work close to the ground — medicines for a patient, books for a child, training for a woman building her own livelihood. Thank you for standing with us.
content.donate.impact1.text: can provide medicines and essentials for a patient in need
content.donate.impact2.text: can keep a child in school with books and supplies

content.getinvolved.heading: Be part of the work
content.getinvolved.text: Not every gift is money. Volunteer your time, share a skill, or simply tell someone about a family we could help. Call us or write — we would love to hear from you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1p: Maa Kalawati Foundation (“the Foundation”, “we”) is a charitable foundation at 4th Floor, Pal Tower, Sikanderpur, MG Road, Gurugram, Haryana – 122002. This policy explains how we handle personal information on this website and in our work, in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and its Rules.
privacy.s2p: Medical support requests: name, age, gender, phone, city, optional address, the help needed, and parent/guardian details for patients under 18. Visitor register: when you visit our office, the visitor book records your name, contact and purpose; we digitise these entries for safe keeping. Donations: completed on our payment partner's site — we do not receive or store your card, bank or UPI credentials. Website: no analytics trackers, no advertising cookies; only two essential cookies (your language choice, and a sign-in session for administrators).
privacy.s3p: Only for the purpose you gave it to us: to arrange medical support you requested, to keep a record of office visitors, to issue donation receipts, and to respond when you contact us. We do not sell personal information, use it for marketing, or profile anyone. We process it with your consent, or for the limited “legitimate uses” the DPDP Act allows — for example responding to a medical emergency.
privacy.s4p: Where a medical support request concerns a person under 18, we require the verifiable consent of a parent or lawful guardian, and we collect the guardian's details for that purpose. We do not track children, monitor their behaviour, or direct any advertising at them (we show no advertising at all).
privacy.s5p: Only with those needed to do the work: the medical partners directly involved in arranging care you requested, and the technology providers that run this website (hosting and database services), who process data under contract for us. We never share personal information for anyone else's marketing.
privacy.s6p: Medical support records: while the request is active and up to one year after it closes. Visitor register entries: up to three years, matching the purpose of an office visitor log. Donation receipt records: as long as tax and accounting law requires. Security logs: about one year. When a period ends, or when you validly ask us to erase your data, we delete it from our systems.
privacy.s7p: All traffic to this website is encrypted (TLS). Personal records are held in an access-controlled database; only authorised administrators can view them, each action is logged, and administrator sign-in uses phishing-resistant passkeys. We keep backups and monitor for unauthorised access.
privacy.s8p: You may ask us for a summary of your personal data and how it has been processed; ask us to correct, complete, update or erase it; withdraw consent at any time (withdrawing is as easy as giving it — one call or email); nominate a person to exercise your rights if you are unable to; and raise a grievance. We respond within {days} days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
privacy.s9p: The Foundation's contact person for data questions is published in the footer of every page of this site along with their email and phone. You can also reach us at our office address above, or by calling {phone}.
privacy.s10p: If a personal data breach ever affects you, we will inform you promptly and plainly — what happened, what it may mean for you, what we have done, and what you can do — and we will report it to the Data Protection Board of India as the law requires.
privacy.s11p: If we change this policy, the new version will appear on this page with a new “last updated” date. This notice is available in English and Hindi; versions in other Indian languages are available on request.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.s1p: This website is published by Maa Kalawati Foundation, 4th Floor, Pal Tower, Sikanderpur, MG Road, Gurugram, Haryana – 122002. By using it you accept these terms.
terms.s2p: Content on this site is general information about the Foundation's work. It is not medical advice, and registering a medical support request does not create a doctor–patient relationship or guarantee support — every request is reviewed individually and support depends on our resources.
